# AI Performance Marketing & PPC

## Overview
AI Performance Marketing and PPC systems automate advertising operations using machine learning, providing efficient audience targeting, ad buying, and campaign optimization. These systems execute real-time programmatic bidding, adjusting bids as frequently as every six minutes based on live engagement signals. They operate across multiple platforms, including Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic DSPs, within a unified ecosystem.

## Core Features
- **Predictive Audience Targeting**: Machine learning models analyze 50+ data points to identify purchase intent and reduce wasted ad spend.  
- **Dynamic Creative Optimization (DCO)**: Tests 1,000+ creative variants automatically, incorporating fatigue detection to rotate ads at optimal intervals.  
- **Full-Funnel Tracking & Attribution**: Server-side analytics provide cross-channel ROI modeling and comprehensive performance insights.
